description: Use this when you need to find mail by keyword, sender, recipient, or subject across every inbox on the account (for example "the invoice from acme"). Read-only; requires auth. Inputs: q (required; every word must match subject, body text, from, or to), limit (optional, default 25, max 100). Returns {q, data:[message summaries including extracted_text]}, newest first. Use cooper_get_message for a full body.

q.description: Search words; every word must match subject, body, from, or to

name: cooper_search
title: Search mail
